_comment: RESUME PROBE, 4 Sep 2026. NOT an arm of transfer_s1 and NOT pre-registered: a mechanism test for the checkpoint relay that arms M and L need. One M-shaped cell (d=512, 16 heads, exact attention, seed 21), 900 steps with a checkpoint every 100. The driver is run once uninterrupted and once with the Colab session killed by hand mid-run; the resumed run must show a resume event with optimizer=restored and its per-step losses must match the uninterrupted run within the bridge tolerance. Passing this closes NOW.md items 1 (CUDA optimizer-state round-trip) and 2 (runner relay) together. Outputs are disposable.
